description.value:
You touch up to four willing creatures, granting each the ability to understand any registered spoken or written language it encounters for the duration, and to speak such a language if it is physically able to do so.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 7th level or higher, this power affects one additional creature for each slot level beyond 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
